topic: Peter Bala's eventual totient-square periods for inverse-function derivative sequences
title: A jet-space proof and extension of Su's theorem on Bala's totient-square period conjectures

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: Using finite jets, we give an alternative proof of the totient-square period conjecture in Peter Bala's comment of 16 February 2026 on OEIS A281181, revision 103, previously proved by Lien-Hung Su (2026, Theorem 3.2 and Corollary 3.3), and extend the argument to every positive integer flow exponent. For C'=C^q S, S'=C^(q+1), C(0)=1 and S(0)=0, the numbers A(q,e,n)=(2n)![t^(2n)]C(t)^e are integers for every positive integer q and nonnegative e, and A(q,e,n+phi(k)^2) is congruent to A(q,e,n) modulo k for every k>=1 and n>=k^2. The proof uses characteristic-p finite jets, commuting matrices, a separate two-adic operator and the Chinese remainder theorem. Five posed conjectures, nine further column specializations and one full-index interlacing are covered.
summary: An alternative proof of Su's results on five conjectures of Peter Bala, extending the square-totient shift to every positive integer flow exponent with sufficient bound n>=k^2. Fifteen OEIS entries have explicit coverage mappings; A281428's stronger original conjectures are cited from Su, not reproved.
